spec.rationale: Prospective calibration cohort ineligible: registration is on or after the observable_after date even though the Q3 FY2026 TTM metric is not yet resolvable from admitted sec_companyfacts at the information cutoff. Types the owner-earnings leg of the operating_business_and_net_assets prose falsifier for CRH plc (26.05 USD per share low / 59.87 base / 128.63 high on the automated owner-earnings reinvestment template bound to epistemic input SHA 1466c983aa1691a1e2a1971d8f90e841179d9fd2). The low-case owner_earnings_reinvestment_dcf proof trace locks owner_earnings at 2,912 USD millions on the admitted work packet (CRH/research/valuation_contract.json traces.low.owner_earnings; FY2025 10-K accession 0001628280-26-009043). If trailing-twelve-month normalized owner earnings at 2026-09-30 resolve below that anchor, distributable owner cash has fallen below the low-case bridge and bounded per-share value should compress toward the low case. Incremental after-tax ROIC and reinvestment-rate legs remain judgment inputs without a resolvable SEC metric and are not typed here. Historical adapter replay on Q3 FY2025 (measurement end 2025-09-30, 10-Q filed 2025-11-05 per CRH/investor-documents/DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST.json) resolved 2,605 USD millions via sec_companyfacts_ttm. At registration 2026-11-07 the resolver still returns ttm_period_inputs_missing for the Q3 FY2026 target period; the admitted manifest lists only DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST.json and does not yet carry Q3 FY2026 companyfacts rows, so the forecast remains ex ante and not look-ahead. Component fingerprint unchanged; only the work-item input digest rebinding (1466c983aa1691a1e2a1971d8f90e841179d9fd2, superseding prior published_input_sha 957bfc913472841cde7599a7c466edad8d1e259b) — forecast thresholds and probability were not adapted to post-cutoff evidence. A 34% fire probability weights cyclical construction demand and integration capex against the prior-year Q3 replay below the low-case owner-earnings anchor.
